title: Fuel tanker fire on Cairo ring road kills at least 31 people
caption:
A fuel tanker crash set off a large fire on Cairo's ring road in the Warraq district of Giza on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, Egypt's health ministry says. At least 15 people were injured, and officials say the toll could rise. The cause is not yet known and authorities are investigating.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
